You'll get the raw textures and a general guide mesh, but you will still need to manually retopologize and clean it up in Blender.I'm pretty sure this specific model wasn't hand-made from scratch. The geometry just isn't accurate for a manual build. On top of that, it’s completely unoptimized: 405.6k quads with only 7 materials is a dead giveaway that a computer automatically converted a messy 817k triangle scan into quads.
